clips.title: The story
paras: Scarlet Monastery now shelters the fanatical Scarlet Crusade in Tirisfal Glades. Once a peaceful center of scholarship and worship for the Church of the Holy Light, it has become a fortified redoubt. Anyone approaching without red colors is treated as a carrier of the plague and executed on sight.

Before the Third War, the Scarlet Monastery was a proud center of Lordaeron's priesthood. Its halls held theological studies and sacred archives, and paladins trained there. When the Scourge brought down the kingdom, surviving defenders held the site against the undead. Those survivors became the zealous Scarlet Crusade and fortified the cloister. Libraries, gardens, and the cathedral became parts of an armed stronghold.

Four wings make up the Scarlet Monastery: a defiled graveyard, an expansive library, an armory, and a grand cathedral. Scarlet Commander Mograine and High Inquisitor Whitemane command its massive garrison. The Crusaders see every outsider as a plague-bearer, living or undead, Alliance or Horde. The Forsaken seek to destroy the garrison that threatens their doorstep, while Alliance leaders increasingly see the Crusade's violent extremism as a dangerous perversion of the Light.
